description: a top at rest near the centre skips the base spin loss (still pays the friction and drag terms)
find: const loss = (BASE_SPIN_DECAY + SPIN_DECAY_PER_FRICTION * top.friction + SPIN_DRAG * top.spin) * DT;
replace:
const sleeping = Math.hypot(top.x, top.y) < 0.15 && Math.hypot(top.vx, top.vy) < 0.05;
      const loss = ((sleeping ? 0 : BASE_SPIN_DECAY) + SPIN_DECAY_PER_FRICTION * top.friction + SPIN_DRAG * top.spin) * DT;
